title: Just Train Twice: Improving Group Robustness without Training Group Information

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group classification accuracy on the CelebA dataset (where the 'blond' label is spuriously correlated with gender) and the CivilComments-WILDS dataset (where toxicity labels are spuriously correlated with mentions of 'male' or 'female').

Evaluating worst-group classification accuracy on the CivilComments-WILDS dataset to measure performance disparities in toxicity classification for comments mentioning 'Black' and 'White' demographic identities.

Evaluating worst-group classification accuracy on the CivilComments-WILDS dataset to measure performance disparities in toxicity classification for comments mentioning 'Muslim', 'Christian', and 'other religion'.
Evaluating worst-group classification accuracy on the CivilComments-WILDS dataset to measure performance disparities in toxicity classification for comments mentioning 'LGBTQ' identities.

Evaluating worst-group classification accuracy on non-demographic artifacts, specifically the Waterbirds dataset (bird type spuriously correlated with image background) and the MultiNLI dataset (contradiction labels spuriously correlated with the presence of negation words).
